description: Create a digital twin lens — a public AI page that answers questions from the owner's own material, with citations — from a profile the user approved in the conversation. Etiquette: summarize the proposed profile and get the user's explicit confirmation before calling this tool, and only include information the user provided or confirmed in the conversation; never fill the profile with guesses. All fields are optional; send only what the user confirmed.

audience.description: Who the lens is meant to help

bio.description: Short biography built from user-confirmed information

boundaries.description: Things the lens should not claim or discuss

context.description: Extra grounding context for how the lens should answer

displayName.description: Public name shown on the lens

facts.description: Standalone user-approved facts that seed the lens knowledge base

locale.description: BCP-47 language tag for the lens copy, e.g. en or nl

sourceSummary.description: What the assistant used to assemble the profile

tagline.description: One-line summary of who the lens represents

topicName.description: Name of the Mindola space that holds the seeded facts

vibeWords.description: Short adjectives that describe the profile

name: create_digital_twin_lens
